conviction_note: The H1 miss was pre-released on 2026-09-18, the full-year guide was explicitly kept, and the stock has already fallen about 9% on it (1,352 to 1,235). The one thing the baseline does not carry is that disclosed shorts have grown to about 5.3% of shares outstanding. That is sized +1.0, and the emitted number is cut to +0.6 because three things offset it: a margin-long overhang of 8.8% of shares that is still growing, 7 of 11 prior print reactions on this name being negative, and the only two pre-announced prints moving -2.3% and -0.9%.
bar: Company's own revised H1 (Mar-Aug 2026) forecast filed 2026-09-18: sales 9,500m JPY, OP 550m, ordinary 600m, NP 400m (previously 10,000/800/850/600). Full-year guide maintained at sales 22,000m / OP 2,200m / ordinary 2,300m / NP 1,600m. Source: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260918/140120260917538104.pdf. print_vs_bar is on OP; +2% is a low-confidence expectation that a downward revision filed 18 days after period close carries a small cushion. It is not load-bearing and is not a finding.
positioning_check: JPX short register (空売り残高報告), latest files 2026-09-28 and 2026-09-29, calculation date 2026-09-25. Barclays Capital Securities 2.33% (432,100 sh), Goldman Sachs International 1.84% (342,300 sh), Morgan Stanley MUFG 1.09% (203,247 sh), total about 5.26% of shares outstanding, roughly 978k shares. The baseline showed 3.17% as of 2026-09-18. Barclays went from 0.45% (calc 09-09) to 2.33%, and all three sellers added after the 09-18 revision. That is about 1.5-3 days of recent volume (225k-860k shares a day). Margin (kabutan 週次信用残, week to 2026-09-25): margin longs 1,629,100 shares (about 8.8% of shares), up from 1,475,400 on 09-18, and margin shorts 0 because this is not a 貸借銘柄. The 信用倍率 is therefore undefined, which is why the baseline's margin_ratio is null. Retail posts (Yahoo掲示板, snippet-grade) say daily margin publication (日々公表) started 09-28; that is not confirmed at JPX. There is no skew, because there is no option market.

findings.finding: Disclosed shorts have grown to about 5.3% of shares outstanding (Barclays 2.33%, GS 1.84%, MS MUFG 1.09%, calc date 2026-09-25), against the baseline's 3.17%. All three built after the H1 miss was already public. They are short into a print that carries no new bad number, because the H1 figures were pre-released on 09-18 and the full-year guide was re-affirmed then. If the release confirms the numbers and keeps the full-year guide, about 1M shares, 1.5-3 days of volume, have reason to cover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean prior on a short-cover reaction at a print. On 2026-07-21 kabutan attributed part of the +27% intraday run (after the 07-16 NVIDIA tie-up) to foreign-broker shorts unwinding after they piled in on the Q1 drop: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2354&b=n202607210336. The two prints that followed a pre-released revision moved -2.34% (2024-10-01, after the 2024-08-20 upward revision) and -0.93% (2025-04-01, after the 2025-03-14 downward revision), computed from the Yahoo daily tape.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-29 (calculation date 2026-09-25); also 20260928_Short_Positions.xls and 20260925_Short_Positions.xls on the same JPX index
findings.why_not_priced: The sealed baseline computed its squeeze term (+1.90) from 3.17% and its building term from +0.20pp. The register now reads about 5.3%, with about +2pp added in the week before the print. If the market were already positioned for a confirmation print, the shorts would be covering rather than adding, because the number they are short into is already public. The stock has held 1,209-1,254 for three sessions on falling volume (225k on 09-29) after the post-revision drop, so selling is thinning while the short keeps growing. This is not an edge in the number; it is how crowded the short is into a release with little new information.
findings.independence: The opposing crowd is the retail margin long of 1,629,100 shares (8.8%), which rose in the week to 09-25 (kabutan 週次信用残: https://kabutan.jp/stock/kabuka?code=2354&ashi=shin). Those holders sell into strength, which caps the upside, and that is why the emitted move is well below this finding's size. Retail posts on the Yahoo board (https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/2354.T/forum, 2026-09-29/30) expect 悪材料出尽くし. That is snippet-grade and is the same crowd, so it is not independent support.

outside_window.finding: The full-year guide needs H2 OP of 1,650m against H2 FY2026 actual of 985m (+67.5%), with H1 progress at 25% of the full-year OP plan against 39.5% (FY2026), 56.6% (FY2025) and 48% (FY2024). If the delayed high-margin 物流DX contracts slip again, the likely point of a full-year cut is the Q3 print in late December, not this one, because the company chose to keep the guide on 09-18. A cut at this print is a tail risk (roughly 10-15%) and is not sized as a finding. The arithmetic is public and the stock has already fallen about 9% on it.

searched_and_found_nothing: Company news page (https://www.ye-digital.com/jp/news/): no September announcement of the delayed high-margin 物流DX contracts being signed. The 09-30 item is a conference talk, and 09-17 AQUA AI HUB and 09-08 MMDigitalFactory are product launches dated 2027-01.

The Q1 決算短信 and 説明資料 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260625/140120260624577840.pdf, ...577886.pdf) and last year's H1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20250930/140120250929563900.pdf): text layers are garbled or image-only, so no order-intake or backlog series could be read. Backlog is therefore unknown.
logmi FY2026 results transcript (https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/384298): 物流DX sales +21.1% and the order lead time named as the issue. No H1/H2 split of the guide was found.

Last year's H1 print (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2354&b=n202510010361): H1 met guide, down YoY, full-year kept, stock -7.74% the next day. On that basis this name has sold a kept guide with a weak H1 before, but that print was not pre-released.
kabutan 2026-09-29 schedule (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2354&b=n202609291121) confirms the Q2 release is due 2026-09-30 (previous release time 16:00). The event is real and has not moved.
No 自社株買い or 配当修正 was found. The dividend was explicitly kept at 15+15 yen in the 09-18 notice.
Parent/customer read-through from Yaskawa: its Q2 print falls outside the window, so it was not pursued.
baseline_tension: The finding agrees with the baseline's positive lean (+2.38, mostly squeeze plus a -17.6% run-up) and only enlarges its short term. It adds nothing directional that the run-up and the register do not already say, which is why it is sized small and the emitted move is smaller still.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: researcher_japan/LESSONS.md holds no rules yet, only open questions, and its question 3 (does a prior 業績予想の修正 kill the event?) was already how this draft sized the print.
